name: Solarvest Holdings Berhad
summary: Solarvest Holdings Berhad, an investment holding company, provides engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning (EPCC) solutions for solar photovoltaic systems to residential, commercial, and industrial properties in Malaysia and internationally. It operates through EPCC of Clean Energy, Clean Energy Generation, Operations and Maintenance, and Others segments. The company engages in the generation of solar energy solutions.
